summary: Split the page into three sequential fragments: (1) header with title, description, date and health summary; (2) models table followed by recent runs list; (3) cost panel and footer with trace info.

shared.style_guide: Use only black (#000), white (#fff) and grey (#777) colours. All text is system font, no bold or italic unless required for headings. Spacing is applied via the shared CSS variables. No decorative elements, icons, or emojis. All class names start with the prefix fa-. Each fragment’s root element is a <section class="fa-component" data-component="…">.
shared.heading_levels: The page title uses <h1>. Section headings inside components use <h2>.

components.purpose: Show the models comparison table and the list of the five recent runs.
components.spec: A <section class="fa-component" data-component="models-runs"> containing a <h2 class="fa-section-title"> with the text "Models" followed by a <table class="fa-models-table">. The table has a header row with cells "Model Alias", "Provider", "Median Call Latency", "Price per 1M tokens (in/out)". Two body rows: first row cells "gpt-oss-120b", "Cerebras", "~1 s", "$0.35/$0.75"; second row cells "mercury-3", "Inception", "n/a", "$0.10/$0.35". After the table, a <h2 class="fa-section-title"> with the text "Recent runs" and an unordered list <ul class="fa-runs-list"> with exactly five <li> items. Each list item contains the five fields separated by spaces: "web-1 rig 4 3.1 s pass", "files-1 rig 3 2.2 s pass", "memory-1 langchain 5 4.8 s pass", "web-2 langchain 6 6.0 s pass", "swarm status-page-6 swarms-rs 7 2.8 s pass". All table cells and list items use var(--fa-fg) for text colour and have padding var(--fa-space).
interfaces: Provides model rows via fa-models-table; provides recent‑run items via fa-runs-list
